decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but the expanding firm has slack to carry a niche maritime line through long defence procurement cycles.
The medical examination light builds on existing competencies and has a dedicated page; with growth and slack there is no shortfall that would trigger search, so the firm keeps it.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires extend a core professional segment with a multi-model line and likely meet aspirations in a growing industry.
The relaunch of a popular designer task light close to the core offer suggests demand at or above aspiration, giving no reason to withdraw it.
